meta.evidence_status: CALC (magpylib 5.2.3 magnetostatics; analytic estimates) - PROVISIONAL; nothing built or measured
meta.note: Early interface file for the handwriting-outcomes study. Superseded by results/board/board_params.json when that exists. Leading option may be refined (see docs/guidance_board.md).

status: PROVISIONAL: CALC and ASSUMPTION only; every value is a hypothesis until the bench force map (EXP-G01) and latency test (EXP-G02) exist

leading_option.name: Magnetic carriage board (architecture i): XY belt stage under a glass writing surface carrying a permanent-magnet head
leading_option.head_magnet: NdFeB cylinder 12 mm dia x 12 mm, N52 class, Br 1.45 T (ASSUMPTION: catalogue grade to verify), axis vertical; force vector set by the head's offset from the pen magnet; spring-retracted Z-lift sets the guidance level and is the power-off state

pen_magnet.part: NdFeB ring 5 mm OD x 2.5 mm ID x 3 mm, axially magnetised, N45 class (Br 1.35 T ASSUMPTION)
pen_magnet.note: Sits on the moving nose of Rev H around the refill; the nose cone must be >= 6 mm diameter from 4.5 to 7.5 mm behind the ball (clears the paper down to 35 deg tilt).

leading_option.variant_under_evaluation: rotating diametric (horizontal-dipole) head: same lateral force, no systematic normal pull, needs a 3rd (rotary) axis

writing_surface_stack_mm.definition: gap = paper top surface (where the ball writes) to the top face of the head magnet
writing_surface_stack_mm.status: CALC (plate deflection under 10 N hand load: 2 mm glass A4 ~0.15 mm) and ASSUMPTION

max_lateral_force_N.direction: isotropic value = weakest direction; best direction ~1.4x
max_lateral_force_N.status: CALC magpylib, pen at 50 deg altitude

software_force_cap_N.status: ASSUMPTION (safety margin below the magnetic breakaway)

continuous_lateral_force_N.status: CALC: a permanent magnet holds force with no power; limited by the software cap, not heat

normal_pull_N.status: CALC magpylib (axial head); diametric variant: 0 when the force is across the pen azimuth, up to 0.8 x lateral force along it
normal_pull_N.note: Adds to the writer's own normal force (1 N nominal) and so to paper friction (mu_eff 0.15)

offset_to_force_slope_N_per_mm.status: CALC (near zero lateral force, gap 2.5-3 mm)

force_bandwidth_Hz.status: ASSUMPTION pending stage model: force follows head position; CoreXY belt stage class, belt resonance ~40-70 Hz

latency_ms.status: ASSUMPTION (1 kHz loop, 1 kHz magnetic sensing, stage lag); Langerak et al. measured ~20 ms total on a slower stage (LIT HAP-16)

position_sensing.primary: 3-axis Hall sensor ring on the carriage measuring the pen magnet relative to the head, plus stage position
position_sensing.status: ASSUMPTION pending the sensing calculation (docs/guidance_board.md section 4)

workspace_mm.board_frame: x right, y away from the writer, origin front-left corner on the writing surface

suggested_simulation_model: F_board = sat_cap(F_cmd) through a first-order lag tau = 8 ms plus 2 ms dead time; normal pull as tabulated; force applied at the pen nose (magnet 6 mm up the axis)
force_vs_gap_note: Pen at 50 deg altitude, azimuth -90 deg (rear toward the writer); isotropic = min over 36 directions of the best achievable force along that direction with <5% sideways component; head offsets searched on a 1 mm grid within +/-14 mm
